# Advanced Aimbot

Source: [2032](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/2032); edited 2023-12-13. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-2032-n1"></a>

- Demonstrates separating slower target selection (0.25-second loop) from per-frame facing updates.

<a id="wiki-2032-n2"></a>

- Target selection filters living enemies by LOS/view cone, vulnerability, spawn state, selected defensive abilities, then scores distance from reticle with barrier penalty.

<a id="wiki-2032-n3"></a>

- Projectile leading offsets target eye position by velocity times approximate travel time; arc compensation is a per-hero/per-ability coefficient indexed through parallel global arrays.

<a id="wiki-2032-n4"></a>

- Hero lookup explicitly accounts for Echo duplication and Ramattra alternate form.

Source limitations:

- Hardcoded hero/speed/arc arrays and ability checks are patch-sensitive and incomplete for future heroes.

- Article acknowledges instant-cast abilities may not work.

- Code fragments use inconsistent numeric global-variable indices across declarations; assembled example needs reconciliation.

- Reviewer observation: no explicit empty-target or zero-projectile-speed guards in shown facing calculation; examples require validation before reuse.
